query: Run a full first-principles experience audit across my whole marketing site in this repo, then give me a forward-looking backlog.
expected_behavior: Grounds first in .resonance/ (or asks for audience and business goal via /grill if the repo does not state them) before auditing
Inventories every page and meaningful state from the routes and rendered output, and audits each without skipping
Runs /system-health and /audit as the baseline safety net alongside the per-page battery
Writes a FUTURE_IMPROVEMENTS.md that is forward-looking (opportunity, why it matters, effort, impact, priority), grouped by theme and ranked, not a changelog of what was done
Hands implementation to /goal and shipping to /ship rather than implementing or deploying inside the audit
